title: China Scholarship Council - Adelaide University Partnership Scholarship Program
about: Adelaide University and the China Scholarship Council partnership for PhD study starting between July 2027 and June 2028. Applications to Adelaide run 1 October 2026 to 1 February 2027; nominated candidates then apply to the CSC around April-May 2027.
requirements: For PhD commencement between July 2027 and June 2028
Requires an unconditional Adelaide offer that depends on also winning a CSC award
After Adelaide nomination, applicants apply to the China Scholarship Council around April to May 2027
The university fee contribution goes only to candidates it nominates

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "For PhD commencement between July 2027 and June 2028" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"All research fields (PhD)" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
